description: Calculate your Human Design chart and ask AI how you're designed to make decisions, build relationships, and find your path. Save the people around you, compare two charts to explore a relationship's dynamics, and analyse how a family or team works together as a group — each with an interactive chart card right in the conversation.

defaultPrompt: Explain the dynamic between my partner and me by comparing our Human Design charts
